description: Short synopsis of each of the differential measurement dashboards.

options.content:
# README - Introduction to M-Lab differential measurements
Matt Mathis, 2025-11-03

These dashboards are intended for public use: Please share.
- See the [short slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1NtlXFFAkwF5HqHWcDcrbh3TrGUdpdHKa1AWJ404kLQ4/edit?usp=sharing)
for a quick introduction.

- See the [full slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1wpx45K30QD2ZIDuS5WsuRGrbcCrxs56cvuhydWRIRiw/edit?usp=sharing)
for a detailed description of the methodology.

- See the [case for deploying servers](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1LBmas8kQtiT9Gv48fBjH3Eqbj4DXIVMGdACnTqr9K78/edit?usp=sharing)
to understand how ISPs can use M-Lab instrumentation to help them
improve their service to their customers, and thereby build a better Internet.

## Global Metro Barchart [link](${detailURL}20250110a)
Display Global interconnect quality (pain) metrics.
Evaluate the interconnections between ISPs by measuring differences in performance to M-Lab servers
from each of the N largest Client ISPs in the metro.
If the score is high (poor) it means that users attached to a some ISPs get different performances
to the different M-Lab servers, indicating non-uniform connectivity between the ISPs.
In all cases high scores suggest peering problems,
and low scores are probably good as long as M-Lab has sufficient coverage.

## Metro Details Dashboard [link](${detailURL}20250114a)
Show the detailed performance statistics between the top N client ISPs
and all MLab sites in the selected metro.
This dashboard is slated to be replaced
by the Regional Details Dashboad, below.

## Regional Details Dashboard [link](${detailURL}20251103a)
Show detailed performance statistics of the cross product of
selected client ISPs and selected M-Lab site in the vicinity
of a selected anchor metro.
This dashboard is feature rich, and expected to continue to evolve.

## M-Lab Calibration Dashboard [link](${detailURL}20251107a)
This dashboard directly calibrates the most important property of 
M-Lab sites (servers): that under equivalent conditions two M-Lab
sites provide equivalent measures of at least one client ISP.
The scores reflect the differences between the two most similar M-Lab sites.
